title: TAOISM | The Power of Letting Go
description:
Mastery of the world is achieved by letting things take their natural course. You cannot master the world by changing the natural way. - Lao Tzu

Our civilization is in a state of ongoing striving in which control seems to be the highest virtue. As opposed to a control-obsessed society, Taoism revolves around letting go and going with the flow. This video explores the power of letting go through key Taoist concepts such as Wu Wei, embracing change, detaching from outcomes, and releasing excess.
